title: Boss-Fight Goal Dependency Map
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:task boss_fight=yes
| stats dc(dependency_id) as dependencies, count as tasks by goal_name
| sort - dependencies
description: Finds major goals whose success depends on unusually many prerequisite tasks.
value: Big goals fail quietly when hidden dependency chains are ignored; this query surfaces the structurally fragile ones.
implementation: Mark major quests as `boss_fight=yes` and count distinct dependency IDs by goal.
visualization: Table of boss-fight goals by dependency count.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which major goals are tangled up with the most prerequisites before you can finish them.
